================================================================================
Bare namespace-macro sentinels before preproc blocks
================================================================================

NS_BEGIN
namespace d {
int x;
}
NS_END

#if defined(X)
    #undef X
#endif
#define X 1
int z;

---

(translation_unit
  (macro_declaration
    (identifier))
  (namespace_definition
    name: (namespace_identifier)
    body: (declaration_list
      (declaration
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (identifier))))
  (macro_declaration
    (identifier))
  (preproc_if
    condition: (preproc_defined
      (identifier))
    (preproc_call
      directive: (preproc_directive)
      argument: (preproc_arg)))
  (preproc_def
    name: (identifier)
    value: (preproc_arg))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (identifier)))

================================================================================
Namespace BEGIN/END macro pairs wrap their contents
================================================================================

NLOHMANN_JSON_NAMESPACE_BEGIN
namespace detail {
int x;
}
NLOHMANN_JSON_NAMESPACE_END
int z;

---

(translation_unit
  (macro_namespace
    (namespace_definition
      name: (namespace_identifier)
      body: (declaration_list
        (declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (identifier)))
